questions.stem: What is the equation for efficiency?

options.text: Efficiency = wasted energy / total input energy
Efficiency = total input energy / useful output energy
Efficiency = useful output energy / total input energy
Efficiency = useful output energy x total input energy

questions.explanation: Efficiency = useful output energy / total input energy. It can also be calculated using useful output power / total input power.

questions.stem: Why can efficiency never be greater than 100%?

options.text: Because friction always doubles the input energy
Because energy cannot be created, so useful output can never exceed total input
Because efficiency is measured as a decimal

questions.explanation: By the law of conservation of energy, energy cannot be created. The useful output can never exceed the total input, so efficiency is always less than or equal to 100%.

questions.stem: A motor uses 500 J of electrical energy and produces 350 J of useful kinetic energy. What is its efficiency?
questions.explanation: Efficiency = useful output / total input x 100% = 350/500 x 100% = 70%.

questions.stem: Wasted energy in a machine is usually transferred to the surroundings as:
questions.explanation: Wasted energy is usually dissipated as thermal energy (heat) to the surroundings, often due to friction or electrical resistance.

questions.stem: A light bulb has an efficiency of 0.15. If it receives 80 J of electrical energy, how much useful light energy does it produce?
questions.explanation: Useful output = efficiency x input = 0.15 x 80 J = 12 J.

questions.stem: Which of these methods can improve the efficiency of a machine?
questions.explanation: Reducing friction with lubricants decreases wasted thermal energy, so more of the input energy becomes useful output, improving efficiency.

questions.stem: An LED bulb and a filament bulb both produce the same amount of light. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The LED bulb is more efficient because it wastes less energy as heat
The filament bulb is more efficient because it also produces heat
Both have the same efficiency since they produce the same light
Efficiency cannot be compared for different types of bulb

questions.explanation: LED bulbs are more efficient because they produce the same amount of light while wasting much less energy as heat, meaning they need less input energy.
